requirement.original: The detail / tool-call panel header displays the full file_path verbatim. When the path is long (e.g. /dev/shm/dev-workspace/applio/.claude/worktrees/overnight-20260423-.../user-fe...), it overflows the detail-panel horizontal bounds. Expected: keep full path accessible (tooltip / copy / tap-to-expand) but visually constrain — truncate with middle ellipsis, wrap, or enable horizontal scroll inside a bounded container. Zero horizontal overflow at any viewport width. This is spec §5.11.
requirement.clarified: In SidebarFileView.tsx the filePath Text (line 49) has no width constraint or numberOfLines limit. On web React Native, this causes the text to expand beyond the 450px panel width. Fix: add numberOfLines={1} + ellipsizeMode='middle' + flexShrink:1 to the filePath style. Same fix needed in CodexPatchView.tsx line 119. Full path must remain accessible via tap-to-copy or similar.
requirement.what: Constrain the file_path text in the detail panel so it never overflows horizontally, using single-line middle ellipsis truncation with copy-to-clipboard affordance for full path access.
requirement.why: Long file paths (e.g. overnight worktree paths in /dev/shm) escape the 450px panel bounds causing layout breaking horizontal overflow visible to users.

root_cause_analysis.symptom: File path text in the right-side detail panel overflows horizontally beyond the panel bounds on web, making part of the path unreadable and breaking the visual layout
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: SidebarFileView.tsx:49 renders the filePath as a plain <Text> with no numberOfLines, no flexShrink, and no maxWidth. On web React Native, a Text with unbounded intrinsic width inside a vertical ScrollView (flex:1) expands to its full content width, escaping the 450px panel boundary. The zero-width space insertion (U+200B after each '/') provides soft-wrap points but does NOT prevent horizontal expansion when no width constraint exists on the Text or its ancestors.

development_approach.strategy: Add numberOfLines={1} + ellipsizeMode='middle' to the filePath Text element, add flexShrink:1 to the filePath stylesheet entry so the RN/web layout engine constrains the text to its parent's width before applying the ellipsis. Remove the U+200B insertion (no longer useful with single-line clamp). Apply same fix to CodexPatchView. Optionally wrap in Pressable to copy full path via expo-clipboard.
